content: Bhela kwa kubha Shelia nde nhwili pela wa mambu ghambone ghaghihikaje, na nga mambu gheni gha chakaka. Bhela nyambiku yela ya Shelia yeibhohakeka chaka hata chaka panga kukotoka, ngacheiweza ng'o kubhatenda bhala bhabhaheghale kunjojabhe Chapanga kubha bhakamilifu!
Ngati bhandu bhabhunjojabhe Chapanga habha bhakabhi bhagholuliki mahoku ghabhu chakaka, ngabhakaliweni mitima jabhu kubha bhabhi na mahoku, na nyambiku yeniheyi yokapi yakabya ikotwike.
Nambu nyambiku yeniheyi ihengakeka kila chaka kubhakombukela bhandu mahoku ghabhu.
Kwa ndandi ngacheiwezikana mwahi wa makambaku gha ng'ombi na imbuhi kubhoha mahoku.
Bhela Kristo paakahikiki pundema, akumpwaghi Chapanga:

content.text: na nyambiku ya kubhoha mahoku ngacheukapalakiki nayu.
‘Lingalya mi pambani, wenga Chapanga, kuhenga mapalu ghaku,

content: Kutumbula akapwaghiki: “Ngacheupala wala ngacheunyambiswa na nyambiku, nhupu, nyambiku ya kujochakeka na nhupu ya kubhoha mahoku.” Akapwaghiki bhenibhela hata ngati nhupu yeniheyi yokapi ibhohakeka ngati mojilaghalaki Shelia.
Kabhete akapwaghiki: “Lingalya mi pambani, wenga Chapanga, nhikiki kughatenda mapalu ghaku.” Bhela Chapanga akabhohiki nyambiku ya mwandi na kubheka nyambiku jaka Kristo pandu paki.
Maghambu Yesu Kristo akahengiki mapalu ghaka Chapanga, tepani tugholuleka mahoku ghitu kwa nyambiku ja hyegha jaki jeakajibhohiki mala punkamu pela kwa bhokapi.
Kila mpenganyambiku Myahude atenda lihengu laki kila lichobha na kubhoha nyambiku yelayela mala pamaheli, nyambiku ambayu ngacheiweza kubhoha mahoku ng'o.
Nambu Kristo akabhohiki nyambiku jimu kwa ndandi ja kubhoha mahoku, nyambiku jejitamakila hata mileli, bhela akatami upambala wa kumalelelu wa chiwoku chaka Chapanga.
Kutumbula chikahi chenihechi alendalela mbaka abhabhekaje maadui bhaki pahi ja magholu ghaki.
Bhela, kwa nyambiku jaki jimu, abhatendiki kubha bhakamilifu mileli bhandu bhokapi bhabhagholuleka mahoku ghabhu.
Na Roho Mhuhu najombi alandila panani ja lijambu leniheli. Kutumbula apwagha:

content.text: Anamekaje Shelia yangu mu mitima jabhu,

content: Kabhete ajonjukela kupwagha: “Nganikomboki kabhete mahoku ghabhu, na mahakau ghabhu ghabhahengike.”
Bhela, mahoku anaghajomwi kubhohakeka, ngakwikubhi kabhete na ndandi ja kubhoha nyambiku ya kubhoha mahoku.
Tunheghalya Chapanga
Bhela, bhalongu bhangu, kwa mwahi waka Yesu tubhi na ukangamalu wa kupajingila Pandu Pahuhu Nakanopi.
Jombi akatuhoghulili indela jahenu, indela jejutulongoha ku womi, jejipeta palipazia lela, yani, hyegha jaki mweni.
Bhela, kwa kubha tubhi na Mpenganyambiku Nkolongwa joabhi na lujiniku mu Nyumba jaka Chapanga,
tepani na tunheghalya Chapanga kwa mtima wa chakaka na uhobhalelu ghoukamilike, kwa mitima jejigholuliki kubhokana na zamili ihakau, na kwa hyegha yeigholuliki kwa machi manyahi.
Tukamulakyaje nakanopi lihobhalelu litu letulipwagha, kwa ndandi Chapanga joatendiki chilanga yaki nde ndongwana.
Tulingalanyaje tabheti kwa tabheti, na kujeghalana mtima kwa upalu na kutenda ghambone.

Wala ngatwikotoka kuhimangana papamu, ngati bhangi mobhabhelile na ntetu wa kuhimangana. Nambu tulakalanyaje, na kujonjukela kutenda bhenibhela, ngati motubhonela kubha Lichobha lela laka Bambo liheghalela.
Kwa ndandi ngati anatujendalili kutenda mahoku kwa nahuli koni tujomwi kuumanya uchakaka, njeta nyambiku jejiweza kubhohakeka kabhete kwa ndandi ja kubhoha mahoku.
Nambu chekihighalila nde kulendalela pela kwa choghohi utemulo wa moto ghoubhelela ghowabhayonangaje bhokapi bhabhumpenga Chapanga!
Mundu jokapi jwangakutii Shelia jaka Musa, akakomakiki panga na chiha anakubhili na ulandilu wa bhandu bhabheli au bhatatu.

Bho, muholakela kubha nde utemulo ukolongwa wa ntundu bhole ghoapalika kupekewa mundu joandongama Mwana waka Chapanga, na kuubhalanga mwahi wa Lulaghilu ghoagholuliki naku kubha nde chindu cha liyaha, na kuntondola Roho Mhuhu joabhi na chihomu?
Kwa ndandi tummanyi jombi joakapwaghiki, “Nepani ananepaje chebhunhengile, nepani ananepaje.” Na kabhete apwagha, “Bambo anaabhatemula bhandu bhaki.”
Nde lijambu la kujoghoha namaa kuhabhukila mu mabhoku ghaka Chapanga joabhi mwome!
Nambu mkombukaje machobha ghala gha kutumbula, pamukamulakiwi uchakaka waka Chapanga. Hata ngati machobha ghala ghakumpatiki mang'ahiku ghamaheli, mwenga mkahinakili.
Chikahi chamaheli mkatonduliki na kupohakeka lihamu palanga, na chikahi chengi mkabhili tayali kulombana na bhala bhabhang'ahakiki ntundu ghonihoghu.
Mkabhabhoni chiha bhandu bhala bhabhakabhi muchifungo, na pamwanyaghuliki hindu hinu mkahinakili kwa chiheku, kwa ndandi mkamanyi kubha mbili na hindu yeibhi yambone nakanopi na yeitamakila mileli.
Bhela, ngamwauhoa ukangamalu winu, kwa ndandi ubhi na nhupu ngolongwa.
Impalika kuhinakila, nahuli ananjomwi kughahenga mapalu ghaka Chapanga mpataje kujopalela chilanga chela.
Ngati moghapwaghi Malembu Mahuhu:

content.text: Nambu mundu jola joahenga ghaghaninyambiha nepani anaatamaje kwa uhobhalelu.

content: Nambu tepani ngachetubhi pachilanda ja bhala bhabhakelabhuka kunyuma na kuhobha, nambu tepani tubhi na bhala bhabhahobhalela na kukengalewa.
